vedic_process.title: Ethical Ahimsa Grazing
vedic_process.detail: Indigenous purebred Bos Indicus Gir cows graze freely in organic open pastures, feeding on natural grass and medicinal flora (Neem, Tulsi, Shatavari). Calf is suckled first with reverence.

vedic_process.title: A2 Whole Milk Boiling
vedic_process.detail: Fresh raw A2 milk is boiled in heavy-bottomed brass vessels over low flame to preserve essential enzymes and micro-nutrients.

vedic_process.title: Clay Pot Curd Culturing
vedic_process.detail: The milk is allowed to cool and cultured overnight into whole curd inside natural terracotta earthen pots to develop beneficial probiotic strains.

vedic_process.title: Two-Way Wooden Bilona Churning
vedic_process.detail: Early morning Brahma Muhurta churning using a traditional wooden churner (valona) pulled bi-directionally with natural jute ropes to separate golden cultured makkhan (butter).

vedic_process.title: Gentle Chulha Clarification
vedic_process.detail: Makkhan is slow-cooked over gentle heat generated from cow-dung cakes and firewood in earthen/bronze pans until crystal clear golden ghee with golden aroma and granular (danedar) texture emerges.

faqs.q: How is Gautattva A2 Ghee different from commercial market ghee?
faqs.a: Commercial market ghee is produced from buffalo or hybrid jersey cows using direct milk cream (malai) centrifugal separation and chemical heating. Gautattva uses ONLY cultured whole curd from indigenous Gir cows churned using authentic wooden bilona according to Vedic guidelines.

faqs.q: Can lactose-intolerant people consume this ghee?
faqs.a: Yes! Certified lab analysis by Jagdamba Laboratories (Report JLFD260702144) verified Total Sugars (Lactose) as 'Not Detected'. The slow clarification process eliminates all milk solids.

faqs.q: Why does the texture look granular (danedar)?
faqs.a: The grainy danedar texture is the hallmark of genuine, unadulterated Bilona ghee prepared from cultured curd and cooled naturally in room temperature glass jars. Uniform liquid or wax-like ghee usually indicates machine processing or hydrogenated fat.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Do not refrigerate. Always use a clean, dry spoon.
